responsibility: This definition module declares the DynamicStrings-based interface to process environment variables. It belongs to the gm2 OS-interface layer and exports GetEnvironment and PutEnvironment so callers can query or modify environment entries using the managed String abstraction instead of raw character arrays.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the interface side of the SEnvironment pair: it declares the String-based environment query/update procedures without implementation details, whereas SEnvironment.mod performs the libc getenv/putenv calls and String/C-string conversions.
